title: Contrast-driven illustration refresh for night theme onboarding
creator: Avery Kim
description: Goal: Update onboarding micro-illustrations, hero screenshots, and inline product images so the onboarding experience meets WCAG AA contrast targets in the night theme and avoids icon legibility regressions. Scope: 14 micro-illustrations across Quickstart flows, 6 hero screenshots (dark theme variants), and a small icon pack (12 icons) used on welcome, API keys, and first-run modal. Constraints: preserve brand tone, keep payload weight <= existing (sprite + svg fallback), and ensure stroke widths are clear at 16px and 24px. Deliverables: updated SVGs and PNG exports (2x, 3x), updated Figma file with annotated color tokens, export checklist, and a short dev handoff doc listing token names and fallbacks.
acceptance_criteria: All micro-illustrations pass 4.5:1 contrast ratio for foreground elements against declared background color in night theme as measured with Axe/Contrast checker
Icons maintain legibility at 16px and 24px with consistent 1.5px minimum visible stroke
Figma file contains a separate 'Dark Theme — Onboarding' page with named color tokens matching platform tokens (e.g., color-bg-night, color-fg-accent-night)
Engineering export artifacts (SVGs + PNG 2x/3x) are uploaded to the design-assets bucket and referenced in the handoff doc
No new image assets increase page weight by more than 10% vs current release baseline
tasks: Audit current onboarding assets for contrast and stroke issues (list of failing assets exported)
Create color-token mapping table and propose 3 alternate accent colors that meet contrast targets
Redraw illustrations to increase midtone separation and adjust outlines for stroke legibility
Produce optimized SVG exports and raster fallbacks with size budget validation
Create Figma handoff page and annotate accessibility notes for engineers
Coordinate dev review and sign-off, iterate based on feedback
